name: Göbekli Tepe
description: Göbekli Tepe, on a hilltop in south-eastern Türkiye, is a site of huge stone circles built by hunter-gatherers some 11,500 years ago, among the oldest megaliths known. Its T-shaped pillars, some carved with foxes, snakes and other wild animals, stand in rings that predate pottery, farming and even Stonehenge by thousands of years.
